+    for _ in range(len(nodes)):
+        previous = set(aliases)
+        for node in nodes:
+            if node.type == 'variable_declarator' and _root_identifier(node.child_by_field_name('value')) in aliases:
+                name = _identifier(node.child_by_field_name('name'))
+                if name:
+                    aliases.add(name)
+        if previous == aliases:
+            break
+    return any(_mutates(node, aliases, response_name) for node in nodes)
+
+
+def _loops(scope):
+    output, stack = [], list(scope.named_children)
+    while stack:
+        node = stack.pop()
+        if node.type in FUNCTIONS:
+            continue
+        if node.type == 'for_statement':
+            output.append(node)
+            continue
+        stack.extend(node.named_children)
+    return sorted(output, key=lambda node: node.start_byte)
+
+
+def _loop_fact(success, loop, response_name, parser):
+    shape = _loop_shape(loop)
+    if shape is None:
+        return None
+    index, array, bound = shape
+    definitions, uncertain = definitions_before(success, loop)
+    definition = definitions.get(array)
+    if definition is None or array in uncertain:
+        return None
+    response_path = _response_path(_expression(parser, definition), response_name)
+    if response_path is None:
+        return None
+    body = loop.child_by_field_name('body')
+    statements = body.named_children if body is not None and body.type == 'statement_block' else [body] if body is not None else []
+    option, control, control_receiver, value_field, value_writes, label_writes, append_line = None, None, None, None, 0, 0, None
+    for statement in statements:
+        if statement.type == 'comment':
+            continue
+        if statement.type in DECLARATIONS:
+            name = _option_name(statement)
+            if name is None or option is not None:
+                return None
+            option = name
+            continue
+        expression = statement.named_children[0] if statement.type == 'expression_statement' and statement.named_children else None
+        if expression is None:
+            return None
+        if expression.type == 'assignment_expression':
+            left = expression.child_by_field_name('left')
+            if option is None or left.type != 'member_expression' or _identifier(left.child_by_field_name('object')) != option:
+                return None
+            property_name = text(left.child_by_field_name('property'))
+            if property_name == 'value':
+                field = _value_field(expression.child_by_field_name('right'), array, index)
+                operator = expression.child_by_field_name('operator')
+                if field is None or value_writes or (operator is not None and text(operator) != '='):
+                    return None
+                value_field, value_writes = field, value_writes + 1
+            elif property_name in LABELS:
+                if label_writes or not _plain_label(expression.child_by_field_name('right')):
+                    return None
+                label_writes += 1
+            else:
+                return None
+            continue
+        if expression.type == 'call_expression':
+            function = expression.child_by_field_name('function')
+            arguments = expression.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+            receiver = _identifier(function.child_by_field_name('object')) if function is not None and function.type == 'member_expression' else None
+            if (append_line is not None or option is None or receiver is None
+                    or text(function.child_by_field_name('property')) != 'appendChild'
+                    or arguments is None or len(arguments.named_children) != 1
+                    or _identifier(arguments.named_children[0]) != option):
+                return None
+            control = _control_id(parser, None if receiver in uncertain else definitions.get(receiver))
+            if control is None:
+                return None
+            control_receiver = receiver
+            append_line = expression.start_point.row + 1
+            continue
+        return None
+    if option is None or control is None or value_field is None or append_line is None or value_writes != 1 or label_writes != 1:
+        return None
+    if option in {index, array, bound, control_receiver} - {None}:
+        return None
+    if _mutated(success, loop.start_byte, False, {array}, response_name):
+        return None
+    if _mutated(success, loop.end_byte, True, {control_receiver}, None):
+        return None
+    if _writes_index(loop.child_by_field_name('condition'), index) or _writes_index(body, index):
+        return None
+    return {'control': control, 'value_field': value_field, 'response_path': response_path, 'source_line': append_line}
+
+
+def option_sources(success, response_name):
+    """Proven (control, value_field, response_path, source_line) option producers."""
+    if success is None or success.type not in FUNCTIONS or not response_name:
+        return []
+    parameters = success.child_by_field_name('parameters')
+    if parameters is None or response_name not in {text(child) for child in parameters.named_children}:
+        return []
+    parser = Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language()))
+    output = []
+    for loop in _loops(success):
+        fact = _loop_fact(success, loop, response_name, parser)
+        if fact is not None:
+            output.append(fact)
+    return output

+"""Replay only the Python analyzer to isolate alternative abstract states."""
+from copy import deepcopy
+from .engine import AlternativeRequired, Engine, merge
+from .constraints import InfeasiblePath
+
+
+def join_states(states):
+    """Widen conflicting table contents; never choose one incompatible write."""
+    joined = deepcopy(states[0])
+    for other in states[1:]:
+        for key in set(joined.database.tables) | set(other.database.tables):
+            if joined.database.tables.get(key) != other.database.tables.get(key):
+                joined.database.unknown_tables.add(key)
+        joined.database.unknown_tables.update(other.database.unknown_tables)
+        joined.browser = merge(joined.browser, other.browser)
+        joined.history = [merge(a, b) for a, b in zip(joined.history, other.history)]
+        joined.symbol_sequence = max(joined.symbol_sequence, other.symbol_sequence)
+        joined.input_sequence = max(joined.input_sequence, other.input_sequence)
+    joined.limitations.append('state budget widening: conflicting database tables are unknown')
+    return joined
+
+
+def run_paths(project, state, entry, params, limit=8, constraints=True):
+    pending, completed, pruned = [{}], [], []
+    while pending:
+        decisions = pending.pop(0)
+        engine = Engine(project, deepcopy(state), decisions=decisions, constraints=constraints)
+        try:
+            result = engine.run(entry, params)
+        except InfeasiblePath as conflict:
+            pruned.append({'reason': str(conflict), 'decisions': decisions, 'conditions': engine.conditions})
+            continue
+        except AlternativeRequired as branch:
+            if len(completed) + len(pending) + len(branch.choices) <= limit:
+                pending.extend({**decisions, branch.key: choice} for choice in branch.choices)
+                continue
+            engine = Engine(project, deepcopy(state), decisions=decisions, conservative=True, constraints=constraints)
+            result = engine.run(entry, params)
+        completed.append({'engine': engine, 'result': result, 'decisions': decisions,
+                          'state': engine.state, 'approximate': engine.approximate})
+    for outcome in completed:
+        outcome['pruned_paths'] = pruned
+    return completed

+"""Model-free CLI. The source index is built once and reused across all scenarios."""
+import argparse
+from collections import Counter
+from functools import partial
+import importlib.metadata
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import platform
+import resource
+import sys
+import time
+
+from .__main__ import analyze, serial, validate
+from .contracts import ContractGrounder, ContractIndex, read_static_context
+from .frontend import Frontend
+from .hashing import sha256, fingerprint
+from .project import Project
+from .state import Database
+from .paths import run_paths
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    for name in ('source', 'skeleton', 'context', 'scenarios', 'output', 'report'):
+        parser.add_argument('--' + name, type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--path-limit', type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument('--no-constraints', action='store_true')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.path_limit < 1:
+        parser.error('--path-limit must be positive')
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    project = Project(args.skeleton, args.source)
+    frontend = Frontend(project)
+    retrieval = ContractIndex(project, frontend)
+    context = read_static_context(project.skeleton.get('context', {}))
+    context['unresolved'].extend(frontend.unsupported)
+    context['unresolved'].extend('Unsupported source route: ' + message for message in project.route_warnings)
+    dump = args.context / 'db-after-warmup.sql.gz' if args.context.is_dir() else args.context
+    database = Database(dump)
+    context['unresolved'].extend(database.warnings)
+    database.schemas = project.schemas
+    paths = sorted(args.scenarios.glob('*.json')) if args.scenarios.is_dir() else [args.scenarios]
+    scenarios = [json.loads(path.read_text()) for path in paths]
+    if not scenarios or any(s['project'] != project.skeleton['project'] for s in scenarios):
+        parser.error('Missing scenarios or project mismatch')
+    if len({s['id'] for s in scenarios}) != len(scenarios):
+        parser.error('Duplicate scenario identifiers')
+    source_digest = fingerprint(project)
+    prepared = time.perf_counter() - started
+    submission = {'project': project.skeleton['project'], 'scenarios': {}}
+    report = {'context': context, 'scenarios': {}, 'run_complete': False,
+              'requested_scenarios': [s['id'] for s in scenarios],
+              'preparation_seconds': prepared, 'model_calls': [], 'path_limit': args.path_limit,
+              'frontend_warnings': frontend.warnings, 'source_parse_errors': project.source_errors,
+              'route_warnings': project.route_warnings,
+              'source_fingerprint': source_digest,
+              'contracts': len(retrieval.contracts), 'input_sha256': {
+                  str(path): sha256(path) for path in (args.skeleton, dump, *paths)},
+              'environment': {'python': platform.python_version(), 'platform': platform.platform(),
+                  'packages': {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in
+                               ('tree-sitter', 'tree-sitter-java', 'tree-sitter-javascript', 'html5lib', 'webencodings', 'six')}}}
+    report['constraints'] = not args.no_constraints
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    def save():
+        validate(project, submission)
+        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(submission, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+        report['elapsed_seconds'] = time.perf_counter() - started
+        report['analysis_seconds'] = report['elapsed_seconds'] - prepared
+        report['peak_rss_bytes'] = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss * (1 if sys.platform == 'darwin' else 1024)
+        report['submission_sha256'] = sha256(args.output)
+        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=serial) + '\n')
+
+    for scenario in scenarios:
+        block, detail = analyze(project, frontend, retrieval, None, database, context, scenario,
+                                args.path_limit, ContractGrounder,
+                                partial(run_paths, constraints=not args.no_constraints))
+        submission['scenarios'][scenario['id']] = block
+        report['scenarios'][scenario['id']] = detail
+        save()
+    report['run_complete'] = True
+    save()
+    print(json.dumps({'seconds': report['elapsed_seconds'], 'preparation_seconds': prepared,
+                      'edges': dict(Counter(e['relation'] for b in submission['scenarios'].values() for e in b['edges']))}))

+"""Source and skeleton indexes. No application code is executed."""

+def text(node):

+def walk(node):

+    for child in node.named_children:

+        self.enum_objects = {}
+        type_names = defaultdict(list)

+                qualified_types[node['fqn']].append(tid)
+        self.enum_prefixes = {tid: (tid if len(qualified_types[node['fqn']]) > 1 else node['fqn'] if len(type_names[node['fqn'].split('.')[-1]]) > 1 else node['fqn'].split('.')[-1])
+                              for tid, node in self.nodes.items() if node['kind'] == 'type'}
+        self.builder_types = {}

+                if decl.type not in ('class_declaration', 'enum_declaration') or text(decl.child_by_field_name('name')) != meta['fqn'].split('.')[-1]: continue
+                body = decl.child_by_field_name('body')

+                for field in body.named_children if body else []:

+                    for var in field.named_children:

+                        if not match:
+                            predicates = None
+                            break

+        self.entities = {}
+        self.column_aliases = {}

+                continue

+                                r'\bname\s*=\s*"' + re.escape(resource['name']) + r'"', annotation.get('args') or '')]

+                        proof = method + ':' + str(loop.start_point.row + 1)
+                        break
+                if proof:
+                    break
+            cache[cache_key] = proof
+        if cache[cache_key]:
+            output.append((values[position][key], members[position], cache[cache_key]))
+    return output[0] if len(output) == 1 else None
+
+
+def partial_url_parameters(frontend, mid, site, state):
+    """Keep known path/query parts even when another expression is unknown."""
+    expression = site['url']
+    tree = frontend.parser.parse(('(' + expression + ');').encode())
+    marker = '__unresolved_browser_value__'
+    while marker in expression:
+        marker += '_'
+
+    def render(node):
+        if node is None:
+            return marker
+        if node.type in ('parenthesized_expression', 'expression_statement') and node.named_children:
+            return render(node.named_children[0])
+        if node.type == 'binary_expression' and text(node.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '+':
+            return render(node.child_by_field_name('left')) + render(node.child_by_field_name('right'))
+        value = frontend.evaluate(text(node), state, extra=site.get('event_values'), definitions=site['definitions'])
+        return str(value) if isinstance(value, (str, int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool) else marker
+
+    from .frontend import browser_url
+    url = browser_url(render(tree.root_node.named_children[0]))
+    values = Engine(frontend.project, state).path_parameters(mid, url)
+    return {key: value for key, value in values.items() if not isinstance(value, str) or marker not in value}
+
+
+def date_interval(phrase, clock=None):
+    if re.search(r'\btoday\b', phrase, re.I) and isinstance(clock, datetime):
+        return clock.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0), clock.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=0)
+    months = {name.lower(): index for index, name in enumerate(calendar.month_name) if name}
+    names = '|'.join(months)
+    found = re.search(r'\b(' + names + r')\s*(?:[—–-]|through|to)\s*(' + names + r')\s+(\d{4})\b', phrase, re.I)
+    if found:
+        start, end, year = months[found[1].lower()], months[found[2].lower()], int(found[3])
+        if start <= end:
+            return datetime(year, start, 1), datetime(year, end, calendar.monthrange(year, end)[1], 23, 59, 59)
+    return None
+
+
+def filter_bindings(project, mid, action, clock=None):
+    match = re.search(r'\bfilter(?:ed)?\b(?:\s+by)?\s+(.*)', action, re.I)
+    if not match:
+        return []
+    phrase = match[1]
+    canonical = lambda word: {'bought': 'purchase', 'buy': 'purchase', 'statu': 'state', 'status': 'state'}.get(word, word)
+    words = {canonical(word) for word in ntoks(phrase)}
+    interval = date_interval(phrase, clock)
+    output = []
+    for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
+        if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
+            continue
+        tid = project.resolve_type(parameter['type'], project.methods[mid]['module'])
+        fields = project.type_fields.get(tid, {})
+        entity = entity_words(parameter['type'])
+        candidates = []
+        for method, meta in project.methods.items():
+            if meta['owner'] != tid or meta['name'] == '<init>':
+                continue
+            node = project.ast.get(method)
+            body = node.child_by_field_name('body') if node else None
+            statements = [c for c in body.named_children if c.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if body else []
+            if not statements or any(s.type != 'expression_statement' for s in statements):
+                continue
+            assignments = []
+            for statement in statements:
+                expression = statement.named_children[0]
+                if expression.type != 'assignment_expression' or text(expression.child_by_field_name('operator')) != '=':
+                    break
+                lhs = text(expression.child_by_field_name('left')).removeprefix('this.')
+                rhs = text(expression.child_by_field_name('right'))
+                if lhs not in fields:
+                    break
+                assignments.append((lhs, rhs))
+            else:
+                if not any(rhs == 'true' and fields[key]['type'] == 'boolean' for key, rhs in assignments):
+                    continue
+                params = dict(project.parameters(method))
+                concepts = (set(ntoks(meta['name'] + ' ' + ' '.join(params)))
+                            - {'enable', 'query', 'filter', 'target', 'start', 'end', 'time'})
+                concepts = {canonical(word) for word in concepts}
+                if not concepts & words:
+                    continue
+                bindings = []
+                for key, rhs in assignments:
+                    value, reference = U, method
+                    if rhs in ('true', 'false'):
+                        value = rhs == 'true'
+                    elif rhs in params:
+                        constants = []
+                        for name, obj in project.enum_objects.items():
+                            owner, member = name.rsplit('.', 1)
+                            label = set(ntoks(member))
+                            enum_type = obj.get('__enum_type__')
+                            owner_name = project.nodes[enum_type]['fqn'] if enum_type else owner
+                            owner_words = {canonical(word) for word in ntoks(owner_name.split('.')[-1])}
+                            if not label or not label <= words or not owner_words & concepts or (entity and not owner_words & entity):
+                                continue
+                            scalars = [v for k, v in obj.items() if not k.startswith('__') and isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)]
+                            if len(scalars) == 1:
+                                constants.append((scalars[0], name, len(owner_words - concepts - entity)))
+                        if constants:
+                            specificity = min(score for _, _, score in constants)
+                            constants = [(value, name) for value, name, score in constants if score == specificity]
+                        if len({repr(v) for v, _ in constants}) == 1:
+                            value, reference = constants[0]
+                        elif interval and 'date' in concepts:
+                            boundary = set(ntoks(rhs))
+                            endpoint = interval[0] if 'start' in boundary else interval[1] if 'end' in boundary else None
+                            if endpoint is not None:
+                                value = Engine.coerce(endpoint.isoformat(sep=' '), params[rhs])
+                                if re.search(r'\btoday\b', phrase, re.I):
+                                    reference += ':context.clock'
+                    bindings.append((key, value, reference, match[0]))
+                candidates.append((len(concepts & words), bindings))
+        if candidates:
+            best = max(score for score, _ in candidates)
+            candidates = [bindings for score, bindings in candidates if score == best]
+        if len(candidates) == 1:
+            output.extend(candidates[0])
+        elif len(candidates) > 1:
+            ambiguous = {key: (key, U, reference, quote) for candidate in candidates
+                         for key, _, reference, quote in candidate}
+            output.extend(ambiguous.values())
+    return output

--- experiments/20261017-ui-event-state/iterations/date-precision-and-reviewed-values/source-code/analyzer/row_arguments.py

@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+"""Click handler arguments for one Vue row scope, without HTML or DOM input.
+
+``decode_row_event`` parses one click expression and returns the row owner
+plus decoded arguments, or ``None`` when anything is unsupported or
+ambiguous. The caller supplies the visible identifier scopes; identifiers
+are never resolved here.
+
+Accepted argument shapes (everything else rejects the whole event):
+
+* ``row.property`` / ``row.property.chain``: static member chain rooted in
+  an identifier bound to a ``row`` scope -> ``{'field': 'property.chain'}``.
+* the whole ``row`` identifier -> ``{'object': True}``.
+* the whole ``index`` identifier -> ``{'index': True}``.
+* JavaScript string / finite safe number / boolean / null literals decoded
+  by the strict decoders of ``row_events`` -> ``{'literal': value}``.
+
+Rejected: unbound or shadowed identifiers, member chains rooted anywhere
+else, computed subscripts, calls, spreads, assignments and other side
+effects, optional chains, optional calls, template strings, malformed
+JavaScript and more than one program statement.
+
+At least one ``row``/``index`` argument is required, and every non-literal
+argument must resolve to the same ``scope`` id; different scopes reject the
+event even when collection and row alias match. A ``None`` scope entry or a
+missing key shadows the identifier.
+"""
+import tree_sitter_javascript
+from tree_sitter import Language, Parser
+
+from .row_events import _BAD, _has_error, _number_literal, _string_literal
+
+_PARSER = Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language()))
+
+
+def _scope_entry(scopes, name, kinds):
+    entry = scopes.get(name)
+    if not isinstance(entry, dict) or entry.get('kind') not in kinds:
+        return None
+    if entry.get('scope') is None:
+        return None
+    return entry
+
+
+def _argument(node, raw, source, scopes):
+    if node.type == 'identifier':
+        entry = _scope_entry(scopes, raw(node), ('row', 'index'))
+        if entry is None:
+            return _BAD
+        if entry['kind'] == 'index':
+            return 'index', entry
+        return 'row', (), entry
+    if node.type == 'member_expression':
+        parts, current = [], node
+        while current.type == 'member_expression':
+            obj = current.child_by_field_name('object')
+            prop = current.child_by_field_name('property')
+            if obj is None or prop is None or prop.type != 'property_identifier':
+                return _BAD
+            between = source[obj.end_byte:prop.start_byte].decode('utf-8', 'replace')
+            if between.strip() != '.':
+                return _BAD
+            parts.append(raw(prop))
+            current = obj
+        if current.type != 'identifier' or not parts:
+            return _BAD
+        entry = _scope_entry(scopes, raw(current), ('row',))
+        if entry is None:
+            return _BAD
+        parts.reverse()
+        return 'row', tuple(parts), entry
+    if node.type == 'string':
+        value = _string_literal(raw(node))
+        return ('literal', value) if value is not _BAD else _BAD
+    if node.type == 'number':
+        value = _number_literal(raw(node))
+        return ('literal', value) if value is not _BAD else _BAD
+    if node.type == 'true':
+        return 'literal', True
+    if node.type == 'false':
+        return 'literal', False
+    if node.type == 'null':
+        return 'literal', None
+    return _BAD
+
+
+def decode_row_event(expression, scopes):
+    """Decoded click facts for one expression, or ``None`` when rejected."""
+    source = ('(' + expression + ');').encode('utf-8')
+    root = _PARSER.parse(source).root_node
+    if _has_error(root) or len(root.named_children) != 1:
+        return None
+    node = root.named_children[0]
+    if node.type != 'expression_statement' or not node.named_children:
+        return None
+    node = node.named_children[0]
+    while node.type == 'parenthesized_expression' and node.named_children:
+        node = node.named_children[0]
+    if node.type != 'call_expression':
+        return None
+    function = node.child_by_field_name('function')
+    arguments = node.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+    if function is None or function.type != 'identifier' or arguments is None:
+        return None
+    between = source[function.end_byte:arguments.start_byte].decode('utf-8', 'replace')
+    if between.strip():
+        return None
+
+    def raw(node):
+        return source[node.start_byte:node.end_byte].decode('utf-8')
+
+    result, scope_ids, owner = [], set(), None
+    for argument in arguments.named_children:
+        value = _argument(argument, raw, source, scopes)
+        if value is _BAD:
+            return None
+        if value[0] == 'literal':
+            result.append({'literal': value[1]})
+            continue
+        if value[0] == 'index':
+            result.append({'index': True})
+        elif value[1]:
+            result.append({'field': '.'.join(value[1])})
+        else:
+            result.append({'object': True})
+        scope_ids.add(value[-1]['scope'])
+        owner = value[-1]
+    if len(scope_ids) != 1:
+        return None
+    return {'collection': owner['collection'], 'row': owner['row'],
+            'handler': raw(function), 'arguments': result}

--- experiments/20261017-ui-event-state/iterations/date-precision-and-reviewed-values/source-code/analyzer/row_events.py	
+++ experiments/20261017-ui-event-state/iterations/date-precision-and-reviewed-values/source-code/analyzer/row_events.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,281 @@
+"""Direct source facts for Vue ``v-for`` rows and click handlers.
+
+Supported subset (anything else is omitted, never guessed):
+
+* ``v-for`` with one bare alias or ``(alias, index)``, the ``in``/``of``
+  keyword, and a collection written as a single plain ASCII JavaScript
+  identifier: ``v-for="(item, index) in myRows"`` / ``v-for="row in rows"``.
+  Any other collection expression (member access, call, filter, parenthesis,
+  literal) is unsupported: its aliases shadow matching outer aliases and
+  arguments bound to it produce no fact. A malformed attribute shadows every
+  identifier it mentions; when no alias can be recovered it shadows every
+  alias visible at that point, so outer rows never leak.
+* ``@click`` or ``v-on:click`` whose value is exactly one call to a direct
+  identifier: ``edit(item.id, 7, 'x')``. Member callees, non-calls, malformed
+  JavaScript and elements carrying both click attributes at once are omitted.
+* Arguments: ``alias.property`` with one direct property of the row alias, or
+  a JavaScript string / finite number / boolean / ``null`` literal. Numbers
+  must be finite, and integer-valued magnitudes must fit
+  ``Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER``. Strings use a strict small decoder; unsupported
+  escapes (legacy octal, unknown escapes, lone surrogates, unpaired sign or
+  any other expression) reject the whole event rather than fabricate a value.
+* A fact is emitted only when every ``field`` argument resolves to the same
+  ``(row alias, collection)`` pair and the nearest v-for binding of that alias
+  is a direct-identifier collection. Literal-only calls, unknown aliases and
+  arguments from different rows or collections produce no fact.
+
+Facts are source facts only: they name the loop collection, the row alias,
+the handler and its argument shapes. No row is selected and no event is
+claimed to happen.
+
+Conservative HTML handling: duplicate attributes, mismatched end tags,
+unclosed elements or a handler value that is not exactly one standalone call
+expression invalidate the whole document, and ``row_events`` then returns no
+facts at all. A v-for that declares no recoverable alias shadows every visible
+alias, so outer rows never leak into its subtree. HTML void elements never
+remain on the scope stack. HTML entities are decoded by HTMLParser.
+"""
+import math
+import re
+import string
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+
+import tree_sitter_javascript
+from tree_sitter import Language, Parser
+
+_BAD = object()
+_MISSING = object()
+
+_IDENTIFIER = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*')
+_VFOR = re.compile(
+    r'\s*(?:\(\s*([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\s*(?:,\s*([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\s*)?\)'
+    r'|([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*))\s+(?:in|of)\s+(.+?)\s*\Z', re.S)
+_KEYWORD_COLLECTIONS = frozenset(('this', 'true', 'false', 'null'))
+_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991
+_VOID = frozenset(('area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'embed', 'hr', 'img', 'input',
+                   'link', 'meta', 'param', 'source', 'track', 'wbr'))
+_ESCAPES = {'n': '\n', 't': '\t', 'r': '\r', 'b': '\b', 'f': '\f', 'v': '\v',
+            '0': '\0', "'": "'", '"': '"', '\\': '\\', '/': '/', '`': '`'}
+_HEXDIGITS = frozenset(string.hexdigits)
+
+
+def _loop_scope(value):
+    """Bindings declared by one v-for value: alias -> direct collection or None."""
+    match = _VFOR.match(value)
+    if match is None:
+        return {alias: None for alias in _IDENTIFIER.findall(value) if alias not in ('in', 'of')}
+    row, index, bare = match.group(1), match.group(2), match.group(3)
+    source = match.group(4)
+    collection = source if _IDENTIFIER.fullmatch(source) and source not in _KEYWORD_COLLECTIONS else None
+    bindings = {}
+    for name, is_row in ((row, True), (index, False), (bare, True)):
+        if name:
+            bindings[name] = collection if is_row else None
+    return bindings
+
+
+def _string_literal(raw):
+    if len(raw) < 2 or raw[0] not in ('"', "'") or raw[-1] != raw[0]:
+        return _BAD
+    body, out, index = raw[1:-1], [], 0
+    while index < len(body):
+        char = body[index]
+        if char != '\\':
+            if char in '\r\n':
+                return _BAD
+            out.append(char)
+            index += 1
+            continue
+        index += 1
+        if index >= len(body):
+            return _BAD
+        escape = body[index]
+        index += 1
+        if escape == '0' and index < len(body) and body[index].isdigit():
+            return _BAD
+        if escape in _ESCAPES:
+            out.append(_ESCAPES[escape])
+        elif escape == 'x':
+            digits = body[index:index + 2]
+            if len(digits) != 2 or any(d not in _HEXDIGITS for d in digits):
+                return _BAD
+            out.append(chr(int(digits, 16)))
+            index += 2
+        elif escape == 'u':
+            if index < len(body) and body[index] == '{':
+                end = body.find('}', index)
+                code = body[index + 1:end] if end != -1 else ''
+                if not code or len(code) > 8 or any(d not in _HEXDIGITS for d in code):
+                    return _BAD
+                value = int(code, 16)
+                if value > 0x10FFFF or 0xD800 <= value <= 0xDFFF:
+                    return _BAD
+                out.append(chr(value))
+                index = end + 1
+            else:
+                digits = body[index:index + 4]
+                if len(digits) != 4 or any(d not in _HEXDIGITS for d in digits):
+                    return _BAD
+                value = int(digits, 16)
+                if 0xD800 <= value <= 0xDFFF:
+                    return _BAD
+                out.append(chr(value))
+                index += 4
+        elif escape in '\r\n':
+            if escape == '\r' and index < len(body) and body[index] == '\n':
+                index += 1
+        else:
+            return _BAD
+    return ''.join(out)
+
+
+def _number_literal(raw):
+    text = raw.replace('_', '')
+    try:
+        value = int(text, 0) if text[:2].lower() in ('0x', '0o', '0b') else float(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        return _BAD
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        if not math.isfinite(value):
+            return _BAD
+        value = int(value) if value.is_integer() else value
+    if isinstance(value, int) and abs(value) > _SAFE_INTEGER:
+        return _BAD
+    return value
+
+
+def _argument(node, raw):
+    """(alias, {'field': name}) or (None, {'literal': value}) or _BAD."""
+    if node.type == 'member_expression' and '?.' not in raw(node):
+        obj, prop = node.child_by_field_name('object'), node.child_by_field_name('property')
+        if obj is not None and obj.type == 'identifier' and prop is not None and prop.type == 'property_identifier':
+            return raw(obj), {'field': raw(prop)}
+        return _BAD
+    if node.type == 'string':
+        value = _string_literal(raw(node))
+        return (None, {'literal': value}) if value is not _BAD else _BAD
+    if node.type == 'number':
+        value = _number_literal(raw(node))
+        return (None, {'literal': value}) if value is not _BAD else _BAD
+    if node.type == 'true':
+        return None, {'literal': True}
+    if node.type == 'false':
+        return None, {'literal': False}
+    if node.type == 'null':
+        return None, {'literal': None}
+    return _BAD
+
+
+def _has_error(root):
+    pending = [root]
+    while pending:
+        node = pending.pop()
+        if node.type == 'ERROR' or getattr(node, 'is_missing', False):
+            return True
+        pending.extend(node.children)
+    return False
+
+
+def _decode_event(parser, expression):
+    """Handler identifier and decoded argument list of one click value, or None."""
+    source = ('(' + expression + ');').encode('utf-8')
+    root = parser.parse(source).root_node
+    if _has_error(root) or len(root.named_children) != 1:
+        return None
+    node = root.named_children[0]
+    if node.type != 'expression_statement' or not node.named_children:
+        return None
+    node = node.named_children[0]
+    while node.type == 'parenthesized_expression' and node.named_children:
+        node = node.named_children[0]
+    if node.type != 'call_expression':
+        return None
+    function = node.child_by_field_name('function')
+    if function is None or function.type != 'identifier':
+        return None
+    arguments = node.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+    raw = lambda n: source[n.start_byte:n.end_byte].decode('utf-8')
+    decoded = []
+    for argument in arguments.named_children if arguments is not None else ():
+        value = _argument(argument, raw)
+        if value is _BAD:
+            return None
+        decoded.append(value)
+    return raw(function), decoded
+
+
+class _Rows(HTMLParser):
+    """Collect direct click facts while tracking v-for alias scopes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, parser):
+        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
+        self._parser = parser
+        self._frames = []
+        self._facts = []
+        self._valid = True
+
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        attributes = dict(attrs)
+        seen = set()
+        for name, _ in attrs:
+            if name in ('v-for', '@click', 'v-on:click'):
+                if name in seen:
+                    self._valid = False
+                seen.add(name)
+        bindings = {}
+        if 'v-for' in attributes:
+            vfor = attributes.get('v-for')
+            bindings = _loop_scope(vfor) if isinstance(vfor, str) else {}
+            if not bindings:
+                bindings = {alias: None for _, frame in self._frames for alias in frame}
+        self._frames.append((tag, bindings))
+        clicks = []
+        for name in ('@click', 'v-on:click'):
+            value = attributes.get(name)
+            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+                clicks.append(value)
+        if len(clicks) == 1:
+            fact = self._event(clicks[0])
+            if fact is not None:
+                self._facts.append(fact)
+        if tag in _VOID:
+            self._frames.pop()
+
+    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
+        if tag in _VOID:
+            return
+        if self._frames and self._frames[-1][0] == tag:
+            self._frames.pop()
+        else:
+            self._valid = False
+
+    def _resolve(self, name):
+        for _, bindings in reversed(self._frames):
+            if name in bindings:
+                return name, bindings[name]
+        return _MISSING, None
+
+    def _event(self, expression):
+        decoded = _decode_event(self._parser, expression)
+        if decoded is None:
+            return None
+        handler, arguments = decoded
+        resolved = {self._resolve(alias) for alias, _ in arguments if alias is not None}
+        if len(resolved) != 1:
+            return None
+        row, collection = resolved.pop()
+        if collection is None:
+            return None
+        return {'collection': collection, 'row': row, 'handler': handler,
+                'arguments': [argument for _, argument in arguments],
+                'source_line': self.getpos()[0]}
+
+
+def row_events(html):
+    """Source facts for click handlers bound to v-for rows in one HTML string."""
+    collector = _Rows(Parser(Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language())))
+    collector.feed(html)
+    collector.close()
+    if not collector._valid or collector._frames:
+        return []
+    return collector._facts

+"""Explicit structured literals, restricted by declared source input fields."""
+import re
+import math
+
+from .nl_inputs import field_role, words
+from .project import text, walk
+from .provenance import entity_words
+from .state import U
+from .structured_literals import literal_value
+from .source_labels import field_aliases
+from .engine import Engine
+
+
+def csv_fields(project, mid):
+    """Only fields split by a literal delimiter inside their declaring DTO."""
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_csv_inputs', {})
+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]
+    roots = {project.resolve_type(p['type'], project.methods[mid]['module'], project.methods[mid]['file'])
+             for p in project.http_parameters(mid) if p['kind'] == 'RequestBody'} - {None}
+    result = {}
+    for method, meta in project.methods.items():
+        if meta['owner'] not in roots or method not in project.ast:
+            continue
+        for call in walk(project.ast[method]):
+            if call.type != 'method_invocation' or text(call.child_by_field_name('name')) != 'split':
+                continue
+            receiver = call.child_by_field_name('object')
+            field = text(receiver).removeprefix('this.')
+            args = call.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+            if field not in project.type_fields[meta['owner']] or args is None or len(args.named_children) != 1:
+                continue
+            if text(args.named_children[0]) != '\",\"':
+                continue
+            alias = meta['name'][3:] if meta['name'].startswith('get') else ''
+            result[field] = {'delimiter': ',', 'label': alias, 'reference': method + ':' + str(call.start_point.row + 1)}
+    cache[mid] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def field_labels(fields, field):
+    """A unique ordered field-name projection may omit one interior word."""
+    split = lambda name: re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+', name)
+    parts = split(field)
+    labels = []
+    for index in range(1, len(parts) - 1):
+        candidate = [part.lower() for part in parts[:index] + parts[index + 1:]]
+        owners = [name for name in fields if set(candidate) <= {part.lower() for part in split(name)}]
+        if owners == [field]:
+            labels.append(' '.join(candidate))
+    return labels
+
+
+def explicit_chain(project, mid, action):
+    candidates = re.findall(r'\(([^()]*?(?:—|–|→|->)[^()]*)\)', action)
+    for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
+        if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
+            continue
+        label = re.sub(r'(?:Request|Dto|Info|Input)$', '', parameter['type'].split('.')[-1])
+        parts = re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+', label)
+        phrase = r'[ _-]*'.join(map(re.escape, parts))
+        if not phrase:
+            continue
+        found = re.search(r'\b' + phrase + r'\b\s+([^,;()]+?)(?=\s+(?:with|for|on)\b|$)', action, re.I)
+        if found and re.search(r'—|–|→|->', found[1]):
+            candidates.append(found[1])
+    paths = {tuple(part.strip() for part in re.split(r'\s*(?:—|–|→|->)\s*', candidate)) for candidate in candidates}
+    paths = [path for path in paths if len(path) >= 2 and all(re.fullmatch(r'[\w][\w .\'-]*', part) for part in path)]
+    return paths[0] if len(paths) == 1 else None
+
+
+def boolean_wire_fields(project, mid):
+    """String parameters converted through java.lang.Boolean.parseBoolean."""
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_boolean_wire_fields', {})
+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]
+    result = {}
+    node = project.ast.get(mid)
+    meta = project.methods[mid]
+    for call in walk(node) if node is not None else []:
+        if call.type != 'method_invocation' or text(call.child_by_field_name('name')) != 'parseBoolean':
+            continue
+        receiver = text(call.child_by_field_name('object'))
+        if receiver not in ('Boolean', 'java.lang.Boolean') or receiver == 'Boolean' and project.resolve_type('Boolean', meta['module'], meta['file']) is not None:
+            continue
+        args = call.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+        if args is not None and len(args.named_children) == 1 and args.named_children[0].type == 'identifier':
+            result[text(args.named_children[0])] = mid + ':' + str(call.start_point.row + 1)
+    cache[mid] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def structured_bindings(project, mid, action):
+    fields = project.request_fields(mid)
+    output = {}
+    for field, typ in fields.items():
+        value, quote = literal_value(action, field, typ, field_labels(fields, field))
+        if value is not U:
+            output[field] = (value, 'action:declared-field-label', quote)
+        if typ.split('.')[-1] != 'String' or 'time' not in words(field):
+            continue
+        role = words(field)
+        label = r'(?:depart(?:ing|ure)?|start(?:\s+time)?)' if role & {'start', 'departure'} else r'(?:arriv(?:ing|al|e)|end(?:\s+time)?)' if role & {'end', 'arrival'} else None
+        matches = list(re.finditer(r'\b' + label + r'\s+(?:at\s+)?((?:[01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d)\b', action, re.I)) if label else []
+        if len({match[1] for match in matches}) == 1:
+            output[field] = (matches[0][1], 'action:time-role-from-field', matches[0][0])
+    numeric = {field: typ for field, typ in fields.items() if field not in output and typ.split('.')[-1]
+               in ('int', 'Integer', 'long', 'Long', 'double', 'Double', 'float', 'Float')}
+    if numeric and re.search(r'\d', action) and re.match(r'^(?:add|create|insert|register|update|modify|set)\b', action, re.I):
+        aliases = field_aliases(project, mid)
+        for field, typ in numeric.items():
+            candidates = []
+            for alias in aliases.get(field, []):
+                parts = re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+', alias['label'])
+                while parts and parts[-1].lower() in ('total', 'num', 'number', 'count', 'capacity', 'amount', 'value'):
+                    parts.pop()
+                if not parts:
+                    continue
+                phrase = r'[ _-]*'.join(map(re.escape, parts))
+                value, quote = literal_value(action, field, typ, (' '.join(parts),))
+                if value is not U:
+                    candidates.append((value, alias['reference'], quote))
+                for match in re.finditer(r'(?<![\w.:-])(-?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+))\s+' + phrase + r'\b', action, re.I):
+                    value = Engine.coerce(match[1], typ)
+                    if value is not U and (isinstance(value, int) or math.isfinite(value)):
+                        candidates.append((value, alias['reference'], match[0]))
+            if len({repr(value) for value, _, _ in candidates}) == 1:
+                output[field] = candidates[0]
+    collections = csv_fields(project, mid)
+    for field, reference in boolean_wire_fields(project, mid).items():
+        if fields.get(field, '').split('.')[-1] != 'String':
+            continue
+        parts = re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+', field)
+        if parts and parts[0].lower() in ('is', 'has'):
+            parts = parts[1:]
+        if not parts:
+            continue
+        phrase = r'\s+(?:(?:the|a|an)\s+)?'.join(map(re.escape, parts))
+        matches = list(re.finditer(r'\b' + phrase + r'\b', action, re.I))
+        values = {not bool(re.search(r'\b(?:no|not|without)\s*$', action[:match.start()], re.I)) for match in matches}
+        if len(values) == 1:
+            output[field] = ('true' if next(iter(values)) else 'false', reference, matches[0][0])
+    for field, meta in collections.items():
+        for typ in ('List<Integer>', 'List<Double>'):
+            value, quote = literal_value(action, field, typ, (meta['label'],))
+            if value is not U:
+                output[field] = (','.join(map(str, value)), meta['reference'], quote)
+                break
+    chain = explicit_chain(project, mid, action)
+    if chain:
+        roles = {}
+        for role in ('origin', 'destination', 'via'):
+            matching = [field for field in fields if field_role(field) == role]
+            if len(matching) == 1:
+                roles[role] = matching[0]
+        for role, value in [('origin', chain[0]), ('destination', chain[-1]), ('via', chain[1] if len(chain) == 3 else U)]:
+            if role in roles and value is not U:
+                output[roles[role]] = (value, 'action:explicit-chain', action)
+        if 'origin' in roles and 'destination' in roles:
+            shared = entity_words(roles['origin']) & entity_words(roles['destination'])
+            shared -= {'start', 'end', 'source', 'destination', 'terminal', 'origin', 'name'}
+            matching = [field for field, meta in collections.items() if shared & entity_words(meta['label'])]
+            if len(matching) == 1:
+                field = matching[0]
+                output[field] = (','.join(chain), collections[field]['reference'], action)
+    return output
+
+
+def canonical_reference(project, mid, field, value, database):
+    """Use a unique spelling from a matching declared entity, without guessing IDs."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip() or field.lower().endswith('id'):
+        return None
+    wanted = entity_words(field) - {'start', 'end', 'source', 'destination', 'terminal', 'origin', 'via', 'list', 'name'}
+    if not wanted:
+        return None
+    normalize = lambda item: ''.join(char for char in item.casefold() if char.isalnum())
+    candidates = []
+    for resource, tid in project.entities.items():
+        if entity_words(project.nodes[tid]['fqn']) != wanted or 'name' not in project.type_fields.get(tid, {}):
+            continue
+        rows = database.rows(project.nodes[resource])
+        for row in rows if rows is not None else []:
+            name = project.materialize(database, resource, row).get('name', U)
+            if isinstance(name, str):
+                candidates.append((name, 'database:' + resource + '.name'))
+    delimiter = csv_fields(project, mid).get(field, {}).get('delimiter')
+    parts = value.split(delimiter) if delimiter else [value]
+    replacements, references = [], []
+    for part in parts:
+        matching = [(name, ref) for name, ref in candidates if normalize(name) == normalize(part)]
+        names = {name for name, _ in matching}
+        if len(names) == 1:
+            replacements.append(matching[0][0])
+            references.append(matching[0][1])
+        else:
+            replacements.append(part)
+    updated = delimiter.join(replacements) if delimiter else replacements[0]
+    return (updated, ';'.join(sorted(set(references)))) if updated != value else None

+"""Explicit selection language links later requests to source-typed objects."""
+from copy import deepcopy
+import re
+
+from baseline_nlp import ntoks
+from .provenance import objects, entity_words, history_value, contains_unknown, source_string
+from .state import U
+
+
+def selected_objects(project, mid, action, history, params=None):
+    selecting = bool(re.search(r'^(?:open|select|choose|take|inspect)\b|\band\s+take\b', action, re.I))
+    focus = re.split(r'\b(?:for|with|without|from|on|onto)\b', action, 1, flags=re.I)[0]
+    words = set(ntoks(focus))
+    observed = []
+    for index, item in enumerate(history):
+        for name in ('result', 'created_objects'):
+            observed.extend(objects(item.get(name, U), 'history[' + str(index) + '].' + name))
+    groups = {tuple(sorted(entity_words(obj['__type__']))) for _, obj in observed
+              if entity_words(obj['__type__']) and entity_words(obj['__type__']) <= words}
+    fields = project.request_fields(mid)
+    groups.update(tuple(sorted(entity_words(field))) for field in fields
+                  if field.lower().endswith('id') and entity_words(field) and entity_words(field) <= words)
+    output = []
+    for entity in sorted(groups if selecting else []):
+        named = [key for key in fields if key.lower().endswith('id') and entity_words(key) == set(entity)]
+        field = named[0] if len(named) == 1 else 'id'
+        reference = history_value(project, mid, field, action, history, entity, use_selection=False)
+        if reference is None:
+            continue
+        parent = reference[0].rsplit('.', 1)[0]
+        obj = next((obj for path, obj in observed if path == parent), None)
+        if obj is not None and not contains_unknown(reference[1]):
+            value = source_string(project, reference[1]) if isinstance(reference[1], dict) and '__symbol__' not in reference[1] else reference[1]
+            if value is not U:
+                output.append({'entity': list(entity), 'value': deepcopy(value),
+                               'reference': reference[0], 'object': deepcopy(obj)})
+    # A later request reusing an observed typed identity establishes focus too:
+    # paying an invoice must not forget which invoice the subsequent edit means.
+    for field, expected in (params or {}).items():
+        entity = entity_words(field) if field.lower().endswith('id') else set()
+        if not entity or expected in ('', None, U) or contains_unknown(expected):
+            continue
+        matches = []
+        for path, obj in observed:
+            if entity_words(obj['__type__']) != entity:
+                continue
+            tid = project.resolve_type(obj['__type__'], project.methods[mid]['module'])
+            for key, info in project.type_fields.get(tid, {}).items():
+                if not info.get('id'):
+                    continue
+                value = obj.get(key, U)
+                rendered = source_string(project, value) if isinstance(value, dict) and '__symbol__' not in value else value
+                if rendered is not U and rendered == expected:
+                    matches.append({'entity': sorted(entity), 'value': deepcopy(expected),
+                                    'reference': path + '.' + key, 'object': deepcopy(obj)})
+        if matches and not any(item['entity'] == sorted(entity) for item in output):
+            output.append(matches[-1])
+    return output

+"""Local aliases for request DTO fields, proven by getter chains in source.
+
+For a handler mid, field_aliases() takes the declared @RequestBody types and
+reports which local variable names are directly initialized (or directly
+assigned) from a zero-argument getter whose receiver resolves to exactly one
+of those DTO types. The getter suffix must match a field actually declared by
+that DTO type (getFoo -> foo), and an explicit source accessor is honored only
+when its body is a single return of that matching field. Names bound to more
+than one type and bindings inside nested methods, classes or lambdas are
+dropped: only the full local name and method:line evidence are recorded, and
+unresolved or uncertain receivers contribute no facts.
+"""
+import re
+
+from .project import text, walk
+
+
+def _getter_field(name):
+    return name[3].lower() + name[4:] if re.fullmatch(r'get[A-Z]\w*', name) else None
+
+
+def _arguments(invocation):
+    arguments = invocation.child_by_field_name('arguments')
+    return [child for child in arguments.named_children
+            if child.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if arguments else []
+
+
+def _declared(project, tid):
+    return project.type_fields.get(tid, {})
+
+
+def _pure_accessor(node, field):
+    """A zero-arg explicit accessor whose only statement returns field (or this.field)."""
+    parameters = node.child_by_field_name('parameters') if node is not None else None
+    if node is None or parameters is None or any(child.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment') for child in parameters.named_children):
+        return False
+    body = node.child_by_field_name('body')
+    statements = [child for child in body.named_children
+                  if child.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')] if body else []
+    if len(statements) != 1 or statements[0].type != 'return_statement':
+        return False
+    returned = [child for child in statements[0].named_children
+                if child.type not in ('line_comment', 'block_comment')]
+    if len(returned) != 1:
+        return False
+    expression = returned[0]
+    if expression.type == 'identifier':
+        return text(expression) == field
+    return (expression.type == 'field_access' and text(expression.child_by_field_name('field')) == field
+            and text(expression.child_by_field_name('object')) == 'this')
+
+
+def accessor_matches_field(project, tid, method_name, field):
+    """Explicit accessors must be pure; absent ones keep the declared-field convention."""
+    explicit = [mid for mid in project.by_name.get(method_name, []) if project.methods[mid]['owner'] == tid]
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_source_accessor_nodes', {})
+    if tid not in cache:
+        cache[tid] = {}
+        meta = project.nodes.get(tid, {})
+        tree = project.trees.get(meta.get('file'))
+        if tree is not None:
+            declarations = [node for node in walk(tree.root_node) if node.type in ('class_declaration', 'enum_declaration')
+                            and text(node.child_by_field_name('name')) == meta.get('fqn', '').split('.')[-1]]
+            if len(declarations) == 1:
+                declaration = declarations[0]
+                for node in walk(declaration):
+                    if node.type != 'method_declaration':
+                        continue
+                    owner = node.parent
+                    while owner is not None and owner.type not in ('class_declaration', 'enum_declaration', 'interface_declaration'):
+                        owner = owner.parent
+                    if owner == declaration:
+                        cache[tid].setdefault(text(node.child_by_field_name('name')), []).append(node)
+    nodes = cache[tid].get(method_name, []) + [project.ast.get(mid) for mid in explicit]
+    return not nodes or any(_pure_accessor(node, field) for node in nodes)
+
+
+_NESTED_BODIES = frozenset({
+    'class_declaration', 'interface_declaration', 'enum_declaration', 'record_declaration',
+    'annotation_type_declaration', 'method_declaration', 'constructor_declaration',
+    'lambda_expression', 'class_body'})
+
+
+def _own_walk(node):
+    """Walk a method body without descending into nested methods, classes or lambdas."""
+    yield node
+    for child in node.named_children:
+        if child.type not in _NESTED_BODIES:
+            yield from _own_walk(child)
+
+
+def _scope(project, mid):
+    """Unambiguous identifier -> (written type, file); plus parameter/local names.
+
+    A name bound to more than one type (an inner block shadowing a field, for
+    example) is dropped, so an uncertain receiver can never provide evidence.
+    """
+    node = project.ast.get(mid)
+    if node is None:
+        return {}, set()
+    method = project.methods[mid]
+    pairs, locals_ = {}, set()
+
+    def bind(name, written, file, local):
+        if not name:
+            return
+        pairs.setdefault(name, set()).add((written, file))
+        if local:
+            locals_.add(name)
+
+    for name, field in project.type_fields.get(method['owner'], {}).items():
+        bind(name, field['type'], field['file'], False)
+    parameters = node.child_by_field_name('parameters')
+    for parameter in parameters.named_children if parameters else []:
+        if parameter.type == 'formal_parameter':
+            bind(text(parameter.child_by_field_name('name')),
+                 text(parameter.child_by_field_name('type')), method['file'], True)
+    for declaration in _own_walk(node):
+        if declaration.type != 'local_variable_declaration':
+            continue
+        written = text(declaration.child_by_field_name('type'))
+        for variable in declaration.named_children:
+            if variable.type == 'variable_declarator':
+                bind(text(variable.child_by_field_name('name')), written, method['file'], True)
+    scope = {name: next(iter(types)) for name, types in pairs.items() if len(types) == 1}
+    return scope, {name for name in locals_ if name in scope}
+
+
+def _expr_type(project, expression, scope, module, file, owner):
+    """Type id for an identifier, this, field access or zero-arg declared getter."""
+    if expression is None:
+        return None
+    if expression.type == 'identifier':
+        entry = scope.get(text(expression))
+        return project.resolve_type(entry[0], module, entry[1]) if entry else None
+    if expression.type == 'this':
+        return owner
+    if expression.type == 'field_access':
+        base = _expr_type(project, expression.child_by_field_name('object'), scope, module, file, owner)
+        field = _declared(project, base).get(text(expression.child_by_field_name('field')))
+        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
+    if expression.type == 'method_invocation':
+        if _arguments(expression):
+            return None
+        call = text(expression.child_by_field_name('name'))
+        name = _getter_field(call)
+        receiver = expression.child_by_field_name('object')
+        base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
+        field = _declared(project, base).get(name) if name and accessor_matches_field(project, base, call, name) else None
+        return project.resolve_type(field['type'], module, field['file']) if field else None
+    return None
+
+
+def _root_field(project, value, roots, scope, module, file, owner):
+    """Declared root DTO field read by a direct zero-arg getter value, else None."""
+    if value is None or value.type != 'method_invocation' or _arguments(value):
+        return None
+    call = text(value.child_by_field_name('name'))
+    field = _getter_field(call)
+    receiver = value.child_by_field_name('object')
+    base = owner if receiver is None else _expr_type(project, receiver, scope, module, file, owner)
+    return field if (field and base in roots and field in _declared(project, base)
+                     and accessor_matches_field(project, base, call, field)) else None
+
+
+def _scan(project, roots):
+    found = []
+    for mid in sorted(project.methods):
+        node = project.ast.get(mid)
+        if node is None:
+            continue
+        method = project.methods[mid]
+        scope, bindings = _scope(project, mid)
+        for statement in _own_walk(node):
+            pairs = []
+            if statement.type == 'local_variable_declaration':
+                pairs = [(text(variable.child_by_field_name('name')), variable.child_by_field_name('value'))
+                         for variable in statement.named_children if variable.type == 'variable_declarator']
+            elif statement.type == 'assignment_expression' and text(statement.child_by_field_name('operator')) == '=':
+                left = statement.child_by_field_name('left')
+                if left.type == 'identifier' and text(left) in bindings:
+                    pairs = [(text(left), statement.child_by_field_name('right'))]
+            for label, value in pairs:
+                field = _root_field(project, value, roots, scope, method['module'], method['file'], method['owner'])
+                if field:
+                    found.append((field, label, mid, statement.start_point.row + 1))
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(found))
+
+
+def field_aliases(project, mid):
+    """Field aliases for the @RequestBody declared types of mid.
+
+    Returns {field: [{'label': local name, 'reference': 'source_mid:line'}]}.
+    Every indexed source method is scanned for direct getter-chain evidence;
+    the scan is shared between calls with the same root type set and results
+    are cached per mid. Fields without proven aliases are omitted.
+    """
+    cache = project.__dict__.setdefault('_field_alias_cache', {})
+    if mid in cache:
+        return cache[mid]
+    method = project.methods.get(mid)
+    roots = set()
+    if method:
+        for parameter in project.http_parameters(mid):
+            if parameter['kind'] != 'RequestBody':
+                continue
+            tid = project.resolve_type(parameter['type'], method['module'], method['file'])
+            if project.type_fields.get(tid):
+                roots.add(tid)
+    result = {}
+    if roots:

+"""Read a MySQL dump as text, retaining independent state for each scenario."""
+from copy import deepcopy
+from enum import Enum
+import gzip
+import re
+
+
+class Unknown(Enum):
+    VALUE = 'unknown'
+
+
+U = Unknown.VALUE
+
+
+class JavaScriptValue(Enum):
+    UNDEFINED = 'javascript undefined'
+
+
+JS_UNDEFINED = JavaScriptValue.UNDEFINED
+
+
+def camel(name):
+    return re.sub(r'_([a-z])', lambda m: m[1].upper(), name)
+
+
+def sql_rows(source):
+    """Tokenize the dump's VALUES tuples, including escaped quotes and commas."""
+    token, row, quoted, escaped, quoted_value = '', [], False, False, False
+    position = 0
+    while position < len(source):
+        char = source[position]
+        position += 1
+        if escaped:
+            token += {'n': '\n', 'r': '\r', 't': '\t', '0': '\0', 'b':'\b', 'Z':'\x1a'}.get(char, char)
+            escaped = False
+        elif quoted:
+            if char == '\\':
+                escaped = True
+            elif char == "'":
+                if position < len(source) and source[position] == "'":
+                    token += "'"
+                    position += 1
+                else:
+                    quoted = False
+            else:
+                token += char
+        elif char == "'":
+            quoted = quoted_value = True
+        elif char in ',)':
+            if token.strip() or quoted_value:
+                value = token if quoted_value else token.strip()
+                if not quoted_value:
+                    if value.upper() == 'NULL':
+                        value = None
+                    elif re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+', value):
+                        value = int(value)
+                    elif re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+\.\d+', value):
+                        value = float(value)
+                    else:
+                        value = U
+                row.append(value)
+                token, quoted_value = '', False
+            if char == ')':
+                yield row
+                row = []
+        elif char not in '(':
+            token += char
+
+
+class Database:
+    def __init__(self, path):
+        self.tables = {}
+        self.schemas = {}
+        self.unknown_tables = set()
+        self.warnings = []
+        db = None
+        opener = gzip.open if str(path).endswith('.gz') else open
+        with opener(path, 'rt', encoding='utf-8', errors='surrogateescape') as stream:
+            content = stream.read()
+        columns = {}
+        inserted = set()
+        for statement in re.finditer(r'USE `([^`]+)`;|CREATE TABLE `([^`]+)` \((.*?)\) ENGINE|INSERT INTO `([^`]+)`\s*(\([^()]*\))?\s+VALUES (.*?);\s*(?:\n|$)', content, re.S|re.I):

+            if use:
+                db = use
+            elif create:
+                columns[(db, create)] = re.findall(r'^\s*`([^`]+)`', fields, re.M)
+                self.tables[(db, create)] = []
+            elif insert:
+                inserted.add(statement.start())
+                names = columns[(db, insert)] if names_clause is None else [a or b for a,b in re.findall(r'`([^`]+)`|\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\b',names_clause)]
+                if any(name not in columns[(db,insert)] for name in names) or len(names)!=len(set(names)):
+                    raise ValueError('Invalid INSERT column list: '+insert)
+                for row in sql_rows(values):
+                    if len(row) != len(names):
+                        raise ValueError(f'Dump row length mismatch: {db}.{insert}')
+                    self.tables[(db, insert)].append({camel(k): v for k, v in zip(names, row)})
+                    if U in row:
+                        self.warnings.append('Unsupported SQL literal retained as unknown in '+insert)
+        for statement in re.finditer(r'^\s*(?:INSERT|REPLACE)\b',content,re.I|re.M):
+            start = statement.start()+len(statement[0])-len(statement[0].lstrip())
+            if start not in inserted:
+                self.warnings.append('Unsupported dump insertion at offset '+str(start)+'; table contents widened')
+                self.unknown_tables.update(self.tables)
+
+    def materialize(self, resource, row, aliases=None, collections=None, primary_field=None):
+        record = deepcopy(row)
+        for column, field in (aliases or {}).items():
+            if column in record and field not in record:
+                record[field] = record[column]
+        db = self.schemas.get(resource.get('schema', ''), resource.get('schema', ''))
+        if (db, resource['name']) not in self.tables:
+            candidates = [schema for schema, table in self.tables if table == resource['name']]
+            if len(candidates) == 1:
+                db = candidates[0]
+        for prop, table, foreign, *columns in collections or []:
+            if prop not in record:
+                norm = lambda value: re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', value.lower())
+                def get(row, column):
+                    return next((value for key, value in row.items() if norm(key) == norm(column)), U)
+                rows = self.tables.get((db, table))
+                if rows is None or (db, table) in self.unknown_tables:
+                    record[prop] = U
+                    continue
+                if not primary_field or record.get(primary_field, U) in (U, None) or any(get(r, foreign) is U for r in rows):
+                    record[prop] = U
+                    continue
+                selected = [r for r in rows if primary_field and get(r, foreign) == record.get(primary_field)]
+                if columns:
+                    value_column, order_column = columns
+                    if order_column:
+                        positions = [get(r, order_column) for r in selected]
+                        if (any(not isinstance(index, int) or isinstance(index, bool) for index in positions)
+                                or sorted(positions) != list(range(len(positions)))):
+                            record[prop] = U
+                            continue
+                        selected = sorted(selected, key=lambda r: get(r, order_column))
+                    record[prop] = [get(r, value_column) for r in selected]
+                else:
+                    record[prop] = [{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != foreign} for r in selected]
+        return record
+
+    def copy(self):
+        return deepcopy(self)
+
+    def invalidate(self, rows):
+        for key, existing in self.tables.items():
+            if existing is rows:
+                self.unknown_tables.add(key)
+
+    def rows(self, resource):
+        schema = resource.get('schema', '')
+        db = self.schemas.get(schema, schema)
+        key = (db, resource['name'])
+        if key in self.unknown_tables:
+            return None
+        if key in self.tables:
+            return self.tables[key]
+        matches = [(key, rows) for key, rows in self.tables.items() if key[1] == resource['name']]
+        return matches[0][1] if len(matches) == 1 and matches[0][0] not in self.unknown_tables else None
+
+    def summary(self):
+        return {db + '.' + table: len(rows) for (db, table), rows in sorted(self.tables.items())}
+
+
+class ScenarioState:
+    """Generic path-local database, browser state and response journal."""
+    def __init__(self, database, context=None):
+        self.database = database.copy()
+        self.context = deepcopy(context or {})
+        self.now = self.context.get('clock', U)
+        self.browser = {'storage': {}, 'form': {}, 'dom': {}, 'url': {}, 'options': {}}
+        self.history = []
+        self.symbol_sequence = 0
+        self.input_sequence = 0
+        self.limitations = []
+
+    def fresh_input(self, label, typ='String'):
+        existing = {str(v) for rows in self.database.tables.values() for row in rows for v in row.values()}
+        normalized = lambda name: re.sub('[^a-z0-9]', '', name.lower())
+        related = [value for rows in self.database.tables.values() for row in rows for name, value in row.items()
+                   if normalized(name) == normalized(label)]
+        excluded = list(dict.fromkeys(value for value in related if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool))))
+        symbols = [value['__symbol__'] for value in related if isinstance(value, dict) and '__symbol__' in value]
+        while True:
+            self.input_sequence += 1
+            value = 'symbolic-input-' + label + '-' + str(self.input_sequence)
+            if value not in existing:
+                return {'__symbol__': value, '__type__': typ, '__constraints__': ['non_null', 'fresh_unique'],
+                        '__distinct_from__': excluded, '__distinct_symbols__': symbols}
+
+    def generated_value(self,typ,kind,existing=()):
+        self.symbol_sequence += 1
+        return {'__symbol__':'generated-'+str(self.symbol_sequence),'__type__':typ,
+                '__constraints__':['non_null'],'__generation__':kind,
+                '__distinct_from__':[v for v in existing if isinstance(v,(str,int,float,bool))],
+                '__distinct_symbols__':[v['__symbol__'] for v in existing if isinstance(v,dict) and '__symbol__' in v]}
+
+    def snapshot(self):
+        return {'browser': deepcopy(self.browser),
+                'history': [{k: item.get(k) for k in ('step', 'entry', 'action')} for item in self.history],
+                'clock': self.now, 'database_rows': self.database.summary(),
+                'limitations': list(self.limitations)}

+"""Explicit field-labelled numeric scalars and numeric sequences only.
+
+A value must directly follow a boundary-anchored field label (the camel/snake
+split of the field name plus caller-supplied source labels), optionally
+through is/of/=/:, and must be a whole finite numeric token. Lists require a
+declared List<Integer>/List<Double> or int[]/double[] type and labelled
+syntax. Repeated labelled occurrences must all parse to one value; a
+malformed occurrence, invalid element or dangling separator yields U.
+Nothing else is parsed: no times, no strings, no roles, no alias dictionaries.
+"""
+import math
+import re
+
+from .state import U
+
+_INT = ('int', 'Integer', 'long', 'Long', 'short', 'Short', 'byte', 'Byte')
+_FLOAT = ('double', 'Double', 'float', 'Float')
+_STOP = re.compile(r';|\s+(?:with|for|from)\b', re.I)
+_CONNECTOR = r'\s*(?:is|of|=|:)?\s*'
+_NUMBER = {'int': r'-?\d+', 'double': r'-?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)'}
+
+
+def _words(value):
+    split = re.sub(r'([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', r'\1 \2', str(value))
+    return re.findall(r'[A-Z]+(?=[A-Z][a-z]|$)|[A-Z]?[a-z]+|\d+', split)
+
+
+def _kind(name):
+    name = name.split('.')[-1].strip()
+    if name in _INT:
+        return 'int'
+    return 'double' if name in _FLOAT else None
+
+
+def _sequence(typ):
+    text = typ.strip()
+    match = re.fullmatch(r'([\w.]+)\s*<\s*([\w.]+)\s*>', text)
+    if match and match[1].split('.')[-1] == 'List':
+        return _kind(match[2])
+    return _kind(text[:-2]) if text.endswith('[]') else None
+
+
+def _number(text, kind):
+    try:
+        value = int(text) if kind == 'int' else float(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    return value if kind == 'int' or math.isfinite(value) else None
+
+
+def _elements(region, kind):
+    parts = [part.strip() for part in region.split(',')]
+    if parts[-1]:
+        parts = parts[:-1] + [part.strip() for part in re.split(r'\s+and\s+', parts[-1], flags=re.I)]
+    parts = [re.sub(r'^and\s+', '', part, flags=re.I) for part in parts]
+    if any(not re.fullmatch(_NUMBER[kind], part) for part in parts):
+        return None
+    values = [_number(part, kind) for part in parts]
+    return None if any(value is None for value in values) else values
+
+
+def _occurrences(matches):
+    """One entry per distinct label span; a span contained in another is a duplicate."""
+    spans = {}
+    for match in matches:
+        spans.setdefault((match.start(), match.end()), match)
+    return [match for span, match in sorted(spans.items())
+            if not any(other != span and other[0] <= span[0] and span[1] <= other[1] for other in spans)]
+
+
+def literal_value(action, field, typ, labels=()):
+    """Return (value, exact quote) for explicit labelled numbers, else (U, '')."""
+    if isinstance(labels, str):
+        labels = (labels,)
+    sequence = _sequence(typ)
+    kind = sequence or _kind(typ)
+    if kind is None:
+        return U, ''
+    matches = []
+    for phrase in [str(field)] + [str(label) for label in labels if str(label).strip()]:
+        words = _words(phrase)
+        if words:
+            label = r'\b' + r'[ _-]*'.join(re.escape(word) for word in words) + r'\b' + _CONNECTOR
+            matches += list(re.finditer(label, action, re.I))
+    matches = _occurrences(matches)
+    found = {}
+    for index, match in enumerate(matches):
+        room = action[match.end():]
+        if index + 1 < len(matches):
+            room = re.sub(r'\s+and\s*$', '', room[:max(0, matches[index + 1].start() - match.end())], flags=re.I)
+        if sequence:
+            raw = _STOP.split(room, 1)[0]
+            region = raw.strip()
+            value = _elements(region, kind) if region else None
+            end = match.end() + raw.index(region) + len(region) if region else match.end()
+        else:
+            token = re.match(_NUMBER[kind] + r'(?![\w.:-])', room)
+            value = None if token is None else _number(token[0], kind)
+            end = match.end() + token.end() if token else match.end()
+        if value is None:
+            return U, ''
+        found.setdefault(repr(value), (value, action[match.start():end]))
+    return next(iter(found.values())) if len(found) == 1 else (U, '')

+"""Explicit mass units, never a default unit for an unqualified weight field."""
+from decimal import Decimal
+import re
+from .state import U
+
+ALIASES={'g':'g','gram':'g','grams':'g','kg':'kg','kilogram':'kg','kilograms':'kg',
+         'mg':'mg','milligram':'mg','milligrams':'mg'}
+GRAMS={'g':Decimal(1),'kg':Decimal(1000),'mg':Decimal('0.001')}
+
+
+def unit_name(value):
+    return ALIASES.get(value.strip().lower()) if isinstance(value,str) else None
+
+
+def mass_binding(field,action,hints=()):
+    words=re.findall(r'[a-z]+',re.sub(r'([a-z0-9])([A-Z])',r'\1 \2',field).lower())
+    if not set(words)&{'mass','weight'}:return None
+    matches=list(re.finditer(r'\b(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*('+ '|'.join(sorted(ALIASES,key=len,reverse=True))+r')\b',action,re.I))
+    if not matches:return None
+    units={ALIASES[word] for word in words if word in ALIASES}
+    units.update(unit for unit,_ in hints)
+    if len(matches)!=1 or len(units)!=1:return U,action,'unit:unresolved'
+    match=matches[0];target=next(iter(units));source=ALIASES[match[2].lower()]
+    value=Decimal(match[1])*GRAMS[source]/GRAMS[target]
+    references=[ref for unit,ref in hints if unit==target]
+    return format(value,'f'),match[0],';'.join(references) or 'declared-field-unit:'+field
